mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows, increasing present value and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below its 20-day moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals a tight labor market that increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenue and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS increase.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals an economic contraction, leading to reduced corporate earnings expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in > 60% of quarters with GDPC1 growth above 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) signals persistent inflation that may prompt aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% (y/y).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1200 thousand units (HOUST > 1200) signal a housing market recovery, which boosts consumer confidence and construction activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1200.
